cases.name: Erika Gwendol Yancey
cases.about: She was a baggage handler. "She was a very caring person," (her aunt Jacqueline) Goodall said, "and she was always around children. She loved children." She was also well-liked by her co-workers, and more than 100 Dulles colleagues attended a memorial for her in Arlington before her burial in Indiana, her family said.
cases.narrative: On 11/19/2008, her body was found in her car. He had stabbed her and slashed her throat int he parking garage outside their apartment, then placed her body in the trunk of her car, which they then abandoned in a parking lot on Sunrise Valley Dr. in Herndon, VA.
